```{r references, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
# insert the references at this position
# set appendix = FALSE, when the report has no appendix
references <- function(appendix = FALSE, part = FALSE) 
{
  require(assertthat)
    assert_that(is.flag(appendix), noNA(appendix))
    if (is_html_output()) {
        fm <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(file.path(getwd(), "index.Rmd"))
        lang <- fm$lang
        ref_title <- sprintf("# %s {-}", c(`nl-BE` = "Referenties", 
            `en-GB` = "Bibliography", `fr-FR` = "Bibliographie")[lang])
        app_title <- sprintf("# (APPENDIX) %s {-}", c(`nl-BE` = "Bijlagen", 
            `en-GB` = "Appendices", `fr-FR` = "Annexes")[lang])
        output <- c(ref_title, "<div id='refs'></div>", app_title[appendix])
    }
    else {
        assert_that(is.flag(part), noNA(part))
        output <- c("\\appendix"[appendix], "\\part*{\\appendicesname}"[appendix && 
            part])
    }
    cat(output, sep = "\n\n")
}
references(appendix = TRUE)
```
